en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Hassan Bin Al Husayn Al farsy, from Suleyman Bin Hafs Al Basry, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The guest, when he comes over and lodges with a people, comes with his sustenance along with him, from the sky. So when he eats, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Forgives for them (their sins) due to him having lodged with them’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Hassan ibn al-Husayn al-Farsiy from Sulayman ibn Hafs ibn al-Basriy who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has stated this Hadith. ‘The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, “
When a guest comes and disembarks with a people, he comes with his sustenance from the sky. When he eats Allah forgives them because of his staying with them/”
